race.description: CSR Building Products C,G&E Mdn Plate
race.comment: SATIRI (9) is a first starter by I Am Invincible from the smart race mare Spright, who has produced three multiple winners from three foals to race. Looked the goods when he took out a recent Warwick Farm trial. Finds a nice race to launch his career. CAPTAIN PEACOCK (1) is back after an 18-week spell. Raced just twice in the maiden campaign and gets a pass mark for his efforts, both on wet tracks. Trialled well here recently and might be a different proposition on a firmer track. THREESOME (10) raced handy but couldn't quicken when resuming from an 11-month break over 1000m at Hawkesbury recently, finishing sixth. Better placed over 1200m and gets winkers on for the first time. Serious contender with the help of the inside alley. GERYON (6) will appreciate this easier race at just his second race start.
